thread:
incident-bot: URGENT: Elevated error rates on gateway-prod-us-west. 5xx rate ~11-13% over last 2m, sudden rise in 429s and 502/504 timeouts. Pager: alex. See runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/gateway-errors

alex (oncall-sre): I'm on it. joining bridge in 60s. any customer-facing impact?

emily (support): Getting multiple reports from two customers (acme, beta-inc) about failed requests and timeouts. they see 502s and some 429s. Ticket numbers: INC-4321, INC-4322.

samir (api): Noted. graphs show request volume normal but error% spikes correlate with a recent rate-limit config push around ~T-3m. pushing full request logs now.

priya (infra): I see a config rollout for global quota service (rate-ctl) at T-4m -> commit id a7f3b. Rolling back?

alex (oncall-sre): Hold changes for now. Can we confirm whether 429s originate from our API gateway or from downstream tenant gateways?

samir (api): Tracing indicates the 429s are emitted by rate-ctl (global token-bucket service) when it tries to enforce a new quota aggregation across zones. Downstream 5xx (502) show backend rejects because quota service returns 429 and then cascade causes connection resets to backend pools.

priya (infra): Patch a7f3b contains an aggressive bucket-move optimization that collapsed per-region limits into a single global bucket. Looks like we inadvertently reduced effective capacity for some high-throughput paths.

ben (platform): If global bucket limits hit, upstream proxies start returning 429 and some gateway proxies are overwhelmed -> connection queueing -> 502/504. We should revert the config immediately and open a mitigation path.

alex (oncall-sre): Action items: 1) Priya revert a7f3b on rate-ctl config (hotfix), 2) Temporarily increase global token capacity to safe level, 3) Enable fallback per-region buckets, 4) Notify support and customers, 5) Monitor for error decline. Priya you own 1+2. Samir own 3. Emily copy to customers. Ben help with rollout guard.

priya (infra): Reverting now -> `git revert a7f3b && ./deploy-rate-ctl --canary 20% --region us-west`

incident-bot: deploy started: rate-ctl revert by priya (deploy id d-7723). Estimated 90s to canary.

samir (api): Applying emergency feature toggle to re-enable per-region buckets: `POST https://control-plane/feature-toggles` body `{ "feature":"regional-buckets","state":"on","targets":["us-west"] }` -- applying to all gateways.

ben (platform): I'll open a temporary override to increase token refill to 2x for high-throughput tenants: `redis-cli HSET token_buckets global_refill 2.0` (we'll revert after). Executing in 5s.

priya (infra): Canary deploy finished. d-7723 -> canary healthy logs: `rate-ctl[canary]: started, serving config revert a7f3b-revert`. Monitoring metrics.

alex (oncall-sre): Any change in 5xx/429 in graphs?

samir (api): Partial improvement. 429s dropped ~60% in canary region. But still seeing 502s in some edge proxies due to queue backlog. We'll need to drain and scale proxies.

priya (infra): Scaling gateway-proxy pods in us-west: `kubectl scale deploy gateway-proxy --replicas=12 -n prod-us-west`

incident-bot: autoscaler bumped gateway-proxy to 12 replicas (from 4) in prod-us-west.

emily (support): Posting status update to affected customers: "We observed elevated errors and implemented emergency mitigations; expected resolution in <30m. We'll post follow-up." Any suggested wording for severity?

alex (oncall-sre): Use Sev-1 for now given customer impact for multiple paying customers. Include ETA for further updates every 15m.

ben (platform): After scale + revert, backend queue depth decreased. I'm also patching gateway timeouts: `nginx.conf: proxy_read_timeout 90s -> 120s` to reduce 504s while caches warm up. Pushing now to canary.

samir (api): We applied regional-buckets fallback for us-west and eu-west. Should prevent single-point bucket exhaustion. Monitoring traces for headroom.

priya (infra): Observability: 5xx dropped from 13% -> 4% in 4m after revert+scale; 429s dropped from 9% -> 2%. Still monitoring for residuals.

alex (oncall-sre): Good. Let's prepare postmortem checklist: cause = aggressive global quota aggregation (a7f3b). Immediate fix = revert + regional fallback + scale proxies + temporary refill override. Next steps = postmortem, stricter rollout gating, load test on quota config, alert tuning to distinguish 429-caused cascades.

emily (support): Updated customers with timeline and workaround guidance (retry/backoff). Customers acknowledged. No data loss reported.

ben (platform): Root config change was poorly tested in staging with production-like tenants. We'll add a canary gating policy: any quota change must pass 10k qps synthetic tests and a slow rollout across regions.

samir (api): Also adding a defensive change: when rate-ctl returns 429s, gateways should return a <=429 with `Retry-After` header and not teardown connections that cause 502s. Filing PR for graceful handling.

alex (oncall-sre): Assignments for post-incident: Priya - remediation plan + rollback automation; Samir - gateway graceful-429 handling; Ben - rollout gating; Emily - customer comms summary; Alex - postmortem writeup and SLA impact calc. Due EOD.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (metrics stable for 10m). Closing alert.

alex (oncall-sre): Marking incident mitigated. Will keep thread open for postmortem notes. Good work everyone. :thumbsup:
